Brief-claimed-by: session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb · batch #403 · 2026-10-26T23:16Z

Director seat, summon #51 continuation (ledger objectstack#12708). Filed by this seat at the maintainer's 「立决策卡」 and presented in batch #403 as item 1 of 2, beside PR #26337's governed-draft line (the PR that implements the clause this card asks about). The card body carries the six items and the facets block; nothing is restated here. Seat increment since filing:
- The two example apps have 25 object files and none declares `ownership` (re-counted on this checkout: app-crm 6, app-showcase 19; `grep -rl '^\s*ownership:' --include='*.object.*' examples` → 0), so under D3 as written every one of them receives `queue`. `packages/platform-objects` (52 files) is `sys_` and skips injection by the existing rule.
- ADR-0142 D1 binds a queue to no object ("records of any `ownership: 'user'` object can sit in"); only assignment rules (D5) are per object. Option C therefore needs a new `objects:` list on the queue entity before it can derive anything — the card prices that in.
- The seat recommends **A** (keep D3; ① picks it and ②③④ do not flip). The maintainer's own words that opened this — 「是不是大部分业务对象都要加个字段？」 — are answered "yes, by design, the same way `owner_id` and `owning_business_unit_id` already are"; B is on the card because Salesforce does it the other way and the maintainer asked.
Prior rulings read: `queue` · `ownership` · `Allow queues` → 8 hits, none on per-object opt-in; ADR-0142 D1/D3 + merge question 1 (accepted at merge); thread: #25769, PR #26337.

Ruling: batch #403 item 1 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-26T23:25Z

Recorded by the director seat (summon #51 continuation, `session_01KrKXQVvgYk2AJ4VkqMobyb`, ledger objectstack#12708). The maintainer answered batch #403 with 「同意」 — the seat letter. Brief 6429607539. Letter **A, ADR-0142 D3 stands as accepted**: `applySystemFields` injects the `queue` column on every `ownership: 'user'` object (the default tier, so every business object in `app-crm` and `app-showcase` today), beside `owner_id` and `owning_business_unit_id`, and withholds it under the other three tiers; no per-object switch (Salesforce "Allow queues", the card's B) and no injection derived from queue or rule declarations (C). The maintainer's question that opened this card — 「是不是大部分业务对象都要加个字段？」 — is answered yes, by design, the ServiceNow shape the ADR's merge question 1 already chose. Not B (a permanent object key whose only gain is fewer empty columns, plus a silent-no-op face when an author forgets it) and not C (a system column whose existence would depend on install order).

Workload of the chosen letter (card column): none beyond PR #26337 as it stands; one sentence in ADR-0142 "Open items" recording this ruling, carried inside PR #26337 (Tier H; the PR is a governed draft and lands by the maintainer's approval).

Execution: the only act this ruling needs rides PR #26337, so this card closes `completed` in this act and the pointer goes on that PR; `needs-user-decision` leaves in the same stroke. `Ruling-ref:` names this comment — the lane cites it in the ADR line. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Closed `completed` by the director seat · 2026-10-26T23:29Z

Ruled A by the maintainer (ruling 6429748166, 「同意」 to batch #403): ADR-0142 D3 stands, the `queue` column is injected on every `ownership: 'user'` object, no per-object switch. The one act the ruling needs — a sentence in ADR-0142 "Open items" citing the ruling — rides PR #26337 (pointer left on that PR). Nothing else to carry here.
